SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF MAY-22-2023 - CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT TO JUN-13-2023 AT 3:30 PM IN DEPT. 506. PLAINTIFF AARON TENNYSON IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT MANFRED ANGSTENBERGER IS PRESENT REPRESENTED BY HIS WIDOWED WIFE SHEILA ANGSTENBERGER. DEFENDANT ANGSTENBERGER FAMILY TRUST IS PRESENT REPRESENTED BY SHEILA ANGSTENBERGER TRUSTEE. HONORABLE PANG LY AMENDS THE COMPLAINT TO IDENTFIY THE PROPER DEFENDANT IN THIS CASE, THE ANGSTENBERGER FAMILY TRUST. DEFENDANT WAIVES SERVICE. PARTIES CAME TO A SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT IN COURT: PLAINTIFF MAY CASH THE DECEMBER 17TH CHECK IN THE AMOUNT OF $2177.10 PLUS WILL RECEIVE AN ADDITIONAL CHECK FOR $597.90. APPEARANCE IS REQUIRED AT THE JUNE 13, 2023 HEARING IF NO PAYMENT IS MADE. IF NO APPEARANCES THE CASE WILL BE DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE PER SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE PRO TEM: PANG LY; CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN. NOT REPORTED.(D506)
